rows.value: Official portal states automatically generated API documentation is available.
rows.product_effect: Documentation only; no authenticated row.

rows.value: Official portal advertises an API console for direct interaction.
rows.product_effect: Console availability is not an execution receipt.

rows.value: Portal requires signup/API-key access before consumption.
rows.product_effect: Without key and response receipt, row count remains zero.

rows.value: Catalogue classifies the API as REST.
rows.product_effect: Transport contract only.

rows.value: Catalogue says the API is based on Connected Nations broadband data.
rows.product_effect: Does not identify snapshot or postcode response by itself.

rows.value: NSUL allocates each current GB address to an Output Area using its UPRN.
rows.product_effect: Current-address geography only; not parcel ownership.

rows.value: UPRN point-in-polygon assigns an Output Area.
rows.product_effect: Point allocation is not title-polygon containment.

rows.value: Higher geographies use Census-population best-fit from the Output Area.
rows.product_effect: Best-fit geography must not be treated as exact boundary.

rows.value: Great Britain coverage, CSV only, six-week releases.
rows.product_effect: Supply contract only.

rows.value: UPRN grid reference is allocated directly by point-in-polygon to higher geographies.
rows.product_effect: Geography QA only.

rows.value: Great Britain coverage, CSV only, six-week releases.
rows.product_effect: No current file bytes acquired.

rows.item: UPRN products are not address products
rows.value: ONS explicitly distinguishes ONSUD/NSUL from address products.
rows.product_effect: No address or premise inference beyond published fields.

rows.value: Postcodes are derived from AddressBase attribution.
rows.product_effect: Licensed source lineage only.

rows.value: Postcodes absent from Code-Point Open are deleted before publication.
rows.product_effect: A missing postcode is not evidence of no property.

rows.value: Shape, Poly_ID, Title_No, INSERT, UPDATE, Vers_No and Rec_Status are mandatory model elements.
rows.product_effect: Paid NPD model; no NPD bytes acquired.

rows.value: Rec_Status values are Added, Changed and Deleted.
rows.product_effect: Deleted records cannot be promoted as current.

rows.value: Poly_ID identifies a polygon; Title_No identifies the registered title.
rows.product_effect: Poly_ID and UPRN are different identifiers.

rows.value: A title may contain one or more index polygons.
rows.product_effect: A polygon alone does not define the whole title.

rows.value: Gaps, overlaps, slivers and underlaps exist; some are genuine and acceptable.
rows.product_effect: No nearest-polygon repair or forced partition.

rows.value: Overlaps below 0.5 square metres are not referred for remedial action.
rows.product_effect: Small overlap is not proof of error-free geometry.

rows.value: Index polygons can be smaller, equal to or larger than the title-plan extent.
rows.product_effect: Cannot be used as exact legal boundary.

rows.value: HMLR index polygons are captured in British National Grid.
rows.product_effect: CRS and transformation receipt required.

rows.value: Change-only delivery contains the latest version; previous versions are not retained.
rows.product_effect: Temporal reconstruction is fail-closed.

rows.value: When registration/title identity is uncertain, official search of the index map is the authoritative verification route.
rows.product_effect: Research geometry alone cannot close identity.
